product_summary: Website dplvalves.com (brand also presented as 'Pure Water Engineers', Unit 124 Raj Ratan Industrial Estate, Malad West, Mumbai 400064; GST shown on site 27AAGCD4601F1Z0; director Mr. Jignesh V. Shah; established 2002; site states sales volume 1.4 Cr and 12 staff). Real catalogue: stainless steel sanitary/industrial valves — Triclover butterfly valves, sanitary butterfly valves, Triclover/three-piece/pneumatic ball valves, zero dead leg valves, flow diversion valves, iris valves, pneumatic diaphragm valves, Crane Saunders block-type diaphragm valves, gate & sluice valves, plug valves (tanker valves), check/non-return valves, actuated valves, pneumatic control valves, deluge valves, dairy valves, sampling valves, flush bottom tank valves; plus SS electropolished tubes and fittings (SMS/DIN/Triclover unions, tri-clamps, ferrules, bends, tees, crosses, elbows, reducers, Victaulic couplings), hoses and bellows, centrifugal and lobe pumps, cartridge/vent/industrial water filters, Y-strainers, conical filters, UV systems, RO with EDI, DM plants, purified water generation/distribution systems, CIP systems, SS storage tanks and manholes, SS turned components, bolts & nuts, caster wheels, orbital welding machines and electropolishing services.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site self-describes as 'manufacturer, exporter and supplier'; core SS valve and fitting fabrication appears in-house, but the catalogue also resells third-party branded items (e.g. 'Crane Saunders' diaphragm valves) and equipment (orbital welding machines, UV/RO systems), so a mixed manufacturer/trader profile is the honest read. All of this is website-declared only.
comment: HS 848180 is CORRECT for the core valve line and is fully corroborated by the published catalogue (ball, butterfly, gate, plug, diaphragm, control, actuated valves) — no HS correction needed for the main product. Status is 'partial' only because the declared single code covers just the valve family: a large share of the real range falls outside 8481 — SS sanitary fittings and clamps (7307), electropolished tubes (7304/7306), pumps (8413), filters/strainers/UV/RO water systems (8421), fabricated SS tanks, manholes, turned components and caster wheels (7326), and orbital welding machines (851580). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a MISCLASSIFICATION of emphasis: the site's own end-use list is pharmaceuticals, drugs, breweries/distilleries, dairy, sugar, textiles, dyes, fertilizers, water treatment and only then refineries/petrochemicals — the true centre of gravity is pharmaceutical/food-grade sanitary (hygienic) stainless steel process equipment and purified-water systems, not oil & gas. Trader signs: resale of Crane Saunders branded diaphragm valves, plus equipment lines (orbital welding, UV, RO/EDI) that a 12-person Malad unit is unlikely to build itself; the site also carries an Infocom/IndiaMART-style inquiry engine and price-list widgets, i.e. a B2B-directory storefront. Product lines missing from the declaration: fittings, tubes, pumps, filters/water systems, fabricated SS items, welding equipment. Per project rules the company is retained; recommended action is to keep 848180 as primary and add the secondary codes above. IMPORTANT: every product claim here comes from the company's own website/catalogue only — no customs line, B/L or GST-verified turnover record was checked in this pass, so the entire product range and the 'exporter' claim are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. The GST number 27AAGCD4601F1Z0 is quoted as displayed on the site, not verified against any registry.
